title: Hunts FH-043S: Team screens, scan hand-off and award wiring for Expedition teams

source.ref: Split from FH-043 (2026-11-16): the database rules, server layer and actions shipped dark behind HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED; the player surfaces move here.

detail:
Owed after FH-043. (1) Web: the team panel on the Trail play page (form a team, show the invite code once, join with a code, lock the roster, leave, the team's progress) calling the actions in app/(main)/hunts/[slug]/play/team-actions.ts; needs a design look. (2) Web: the scan landing and POST at app/(main)/hunts/p/[code]/route.ts still credit only the caller's own run, so a team member who is not captain must type the code on the play page today; route a team member's scan through claimAsTeamMember. (3) Game systems: nothing calls hunt_team_award_allocate yet. hunt_reward_grant still grants a finished team run's reward to the captain; decide per reward whether the team holds one unit or a split, and call the allocation when the grant lands. (4) Database owner: apply migration 20270346082000_hunt_teams_editions.sql through the serialized gate and confirm supabase/tests/hunt_teams.test.sql passes in db-tests; check by hand with two sessions that two members claiming one stop queue on the team row lock. (5) Owner decision: whether teammates may see each other's display names (docs/hunts/ROLE-MATRIX.md has no roster view; the store returns a count only). Done when: a non-captain member scans a stop's code and the team run is credited once, and a signed-out visitor, an outsider and a departed member see no team data. Requires: FH-043, FH-016. Owner role: Web, with Identity and game systems.

2026-11-18: closed by its probe. Built (1) and (2): components/hunts/team-panel.tsx on the Trail play page (start a team and show the invite code and join link once, join from the captain's link, captain locks the roster, leave, the team's stop count via myTeamPanel; the solo confirm form steps aside for a team member), and the scan hand-off: the public landing issues a token bound to the TEAM run (openTeamClaim in lib/hunts/team-store.ts), and POST /hunts/p/[code] routes a team member through claimAsTeamMember, which verifies that token and shares the typed form's idempotency key (teamClaimKey), so a scan after a typed code replays. Tests: lib/hunts/team-store.test.ts, the route and both page tests. Not done here and still owed, filed as FH-043T: (3) award wiring (nothing calls hunt_team_award_allocate; hunt_reward_grant still grants a team run's reward to the captain), (4) applying migration 20270346082000_hunt_teams_editions.sql and the two-session lock check, (5) the owner's call on teammates seeing display names, and a design look at the panel. Switches stay OFF.
